Andrei Popescu
Senior Backend Engineer
andrei.popescu@example.com · +1-555-007-0707 · Bucharest, Romania
Hybrid · Remote · EU Citizen · Notice period: 30 days
SUMMARY
Andrei Popescu is a senior backend engineer based in Bucharest, Romania, with 7 years of total experience.
Expertise spans Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis, and AWS within the Cloud Computing and
Financial Technology industries. Holds a bachelor degree in Computer Science and demonstrates leadership
experience in backend development. Communicates in Romanian and English, and is available on a 30 day
notice period for hybrid or remote roles.

Python (7 years) · Django (5 years) · PostgreSQL (7 years) · Docker (4 years) · Redis (3 years) ·
AWS (4 years)

Industry: Cloud Computing
• Worked as a Senior Backend Engineer in the Cloud Computing industry using Python, Django,
PostgreSQL, and AWS.
• Provided backend engineering leadership across various cloud projects.
Backend Developer — Carpathian Software Jun 2019 – Feb 2021
Industry: Financial Technology
• Served as a Backend Developer within the Financial Technology industry utilizing Python, Docker, and
Redis.
• Delivered backend solutions without holding a leadership role during this period.

Universitatea Politehnica din Bucuresti
